metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the horn, the first leaf, and John's count of the ladies.

yesterday: You are in the Shrew at two. In the morning the book is read at Dick's, and you are the one who reads it.
The dairymaid stays. Kemp has already seen her. Maria and Katharine are two boys out of Pope's parish at three shillings the week. Sincler is the messenger, in black. John takes the schoolmaster.
He said the Princess wants a gown.
You stayed in. Titus and the first Tamburlaine played.
You began a leaf and dated it in the old year. The sentence to Anne is still on the desk.
